name: E2213KS0E1
description: 2.13-inch monochrome wide-temperature panel, 212 × 104; tentative 2023 electrical characterization.
scope: Panel and its display driver/reference circuit under cited test conditions; host MCU, radio, upstream converter, optional adapter board, touch and frontlight consumption are not included.

operations.note: 3 V × 2.3 mA × 2.4 s. Current trace on page 14 supports mean-current interpretation. Vendor test jig and price-label pattern, 25 ± 2 °C.
Product page lists fast update support, but mode-specific electrical data were not established in the reviewed pages.

states.note: Image retention without power does not establish standby current of the powered controller or attached board.

entries.name: SDA
entries.note: Pin table lists type I but description says input/output; retain this ambiguity until checked against the selected controller.

pins.note: Vendor pin names retained for this exact document revision. These are research metadata, not executable engine ports. Booster nodes and capacitor pins are not generic load supply rails.

limitations: Datasheet is explicitly tentative and distributor-hosted; do not treat as a final guaranteed specification.
Current product page's linked flyer describes geometry/material but does not validate these electrical figures.
Standby/deep-sleep power and fast-refresh energy remain unknown.
21 mA is a typical peak, not a maximum; average energy alone cannot size the supply/storage path.
Derived energy assumes the typical power/current applies over the stated refresh interval. Actual energy needs a complete operation trace.
Full-refresh preset is available in preset.json. Unknown modes remain null; Pervasive requires explicit idle power.
